meta.title: Causal designs in Danish register-data papers
meta.tagline: Every empirical design behind a paper's results, one entry per design: the identification strategy and its sub-design, the source of variation, the instrument, and the result records it carries with their estimand, estimate and assumptions.
meta.description: One entry per DESIGN of a paper — a group of result records sharing an identification strategy (family), a sub-design from the design taxonomy, a source of exogenous variation and an instrument — with the records themselves as rows: statement, treatment and outcome with their concepts, sign and point estimate, estimand type, population, estimator and exhibit, the key assumptions and the threats discussed. Records the taxonomy pass did not place (descriptive results, papers not yet placed) form one design per strategy, flagged. The records are produced OUTSIDE Metalens by the danish-register-econ agent pipeline (the result-claims pass with identification blocks, then the design-taxonomy pass); this preset is the schema they are imported into, not the recipe that made them. The companion of the Claims in empirical economics papers preset, which holds the same corpus' stated claims.
